title: Implosive Dynamics from Topological Quenches in Bose-Einstein Condensates
summary: We show numerically that a repulsive Bose-Einstein condensate can be driven into implosive dynamics by a direct topological quench. We first realize giant vortices by quasi-adiabatic phase imprinting, and then perform a sudden anti-imprint that cancels the accumulated winding in a single step, abruptly switching the condensate from a highly charged vortex state to the trivial sector. The resulting phase-density mismatch launches a rapid inward radial flow and produces a strong central density buildup, despite the repulsive interactions.
